T013 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (YEucl n)),
  (∀ (m : ℕ) (x y : YEucl m) (t u : ℝ), dist (YJoin x t) (YJoin y u) = √(dist x y ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2)) ∧
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (z : YEucl (m + 1)), YJoin (YBase z) (YLast z) = z) ∧
        (∀ (m : ℕ) (x : YEucl m) (t : ℝ), YBase (YJoin x t) = x ∧ YLast (YJoin x t) = t) ∧
          (∀ (m : ℕ), LipschitzWith 1 YBase ∧ LipschitzWith 1 YLast) ∧ Isometry YLine ∧ Function.Surjective YLine →
    (1 ≤ n →
        ∀ (q : ℝ),
          0 < q →
            dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q →
              ∀ (r : ℝ),
                0 < r →
                  r ≤ 1 →
                    ∀ (ε : ℝ),
                      0 < ε →
                        ∃ U,
                          YCover r E U ∧
                            (∀ (i : ℕ), (U i).Nonempty → 0 < Metric.ediam (U i)) ∧ YCost q U < ENNReal.ofReal ε) →
      1 ≤ n →
        ∀ (q : ℝ),
          0 < q →
            dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q →
              ∀ (r : ℝ),
                0 < r →
                  r ≤ 1 →
                    ∀ (ε : ℝ),
                      0 < ε → ∃ V, YCover (√2 * r) (YF E) V ∧ YCost (q + 1) V < ENNReal.ofReal (2 * √2 ^ (q + 1) * ε)
'Translation.T013' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
